A N G E L A | R Y E on Instagram: "Support a TSO. The TSA workers have just begun working after not receiving a FULL paycheck. Support these folks…donate. Say thank you. Follow instructions. Put yourself in their shoes. 🥺

Call your Members of Congress and tell them to say NO to the SAVE Act, but yes to separately funding TSOs!"
content.text: Support a TSO. The TSA workers have just begun working after not receiving a FULL paycheck. Support these folks…donate. Say thank you. Follow instructions. Put yourself in their shoes. 🥺Call your Members of Congress and tell them to say NO to the SAVE Act, but yes to separately funding TSOs!Ask your people to stop trying to put weird things in the bill like trans surgeries and men in women’s bathroom. Ask that first please 😐No one should be expected to work without a paycheck. Fact of the matter this shows why people dont vote. Politicians are out of touch to force the workers to take a hit for their fight. Also, they dont want to fund DHS, but still there is no proposal for immigration reform from either side. Im convinced both sides really dont want to fix the underlying issue because it divides the electorate.Thank you!!!!🙏🏾 🙏🏾🙏🏾🙏🏾 For your kindness!!!! You right!!!!🤔🤔🤔🤔 #nopayThey've had boxes of Kraft Mac & Cheese in the breakrooms at DFW Airport for TSA workers. I'm not joking.I feel terrible for them but The Airline CEO's who make $20M a year need to get together and donate.2 of my siblings work for TSA out of Seatac. The stories I have been hearing are heartbreaking. I also just flew from New Orleans and everyone was smiling. I love that their joy did not appear to be taken because I know I would mad AF coming to work everyday not being paid. No smiles from me.Dems introduced a bill FIVE TIMES to pay TSA and the GOP voted NO every time bc as long as they can point the finger at the Dems for holding out on funding ICE, they will. The DNC needs to do a better job of educating in these moments. The joint, coordinated social media campaign they should be pushing forward is not happening and that’s unfortunateThere is an article in The Guardian titled “US airports ask for donations for unpaid TSA staff amid partial government shutdown” it notes there is an effort to accept donations on site at several airports. They encourage gift cards over other items like food and clothing. Angela is right, call your representative and tell them TSA must be paid for the sake of the traveling public.I gave two of the gifts cards. I couldn’t imagine working for freeI have a neice with four children. One has autism and it is absolutely heartbreaking the way innocent people are caught in this disaster. They don't have resources this shut down 😢Love you, and love the work that you do, my sister! Had the opportunity to see you once in Washington DC during a convention @ WCC. Will support the cause. Paul ThorpeYou can't give them anything abd if they're seen on camera accepting something they will be firedThese officers are doing no the work of the empire. The department of Homeland security has chosen not to make funding available to these officers while paying other officers in the system. Respect to the humans that are faced with the dilemma of missing a paycheck. That paycheck does come from the empire and the department that is terrorizing families and killing people. I think a more just and humane call to action is finding folks another job. A just transition. This is better than asking your audience to subsidize an prop up the pawns of empire.Comments on this post have been limited.
